source_text: 1Hero! You made it!

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp.1Hero! You made it!
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp.1Hero! You made it!"

translation: 1Hero! Udało ci się dotrzeć!

source_text: So, we’re good? It’s all mine?

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.So, we’re good? It’s all mine?
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.So, we’re good? It’s all mine?"

translation: Czyli wszystko gra? To wszystko moje?

source_text: 1Hero! I thought you’d be home.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.1Hero! I thought you’d be home.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.1Hero! I thought you’d be home."

translation: 1Hero! Myślałam, że będziesz w domu.

source_text: Why did you leave Heather’s house? They are worried sick.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Why did you leave Heather’s house? They are worried sick.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Why did you leave Heather’s house? They are worried sick."

translation: Czemu wyszłaś z domu Heather? Strasznie się o ciebie martwią.

source_text: Oh, my. I didn’t mean to frighten them. I was just…

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.Oh, my. I didn’t mean to frighten them. I was just…
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.Oh, my. I didn’t mean to frighten them. I was just…"

translation: Och, nie chciałam ich przestraszyć. Po prostu…

source_text: I wanted to see you.

structure.raw_value: JuSaEx.I wanted to see you.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaEx.I wanted to see you."

translation: Chciałam cię zobaczyć.

source_text: You could have called me.

structure.raw_value: McSaOp.You could have called me.
structure.script_literal: "McSaOp.You could have called me."

translation: Mogłaś do mnie zadzwonić.

source_text: I must admit… I was worried you’d be with Erica.

structure.raw_value: JuWoCl.I must admit… I was worried you’d be with Erica.
structure.script_literal: "JuWoCl.I must admit… I was worried you’d be with Erica."

translation: Muszę przyznać… martwiłam się, że będziesz z Ericą.

source_text: Huh? You wanted to see if she was spending the night?

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Huh? You wanted to see if she was spending the night?
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Huh? You wanted to see if she was spending the night?"

translation: Co? Chciałaś sprawdzić, czy zostanie na noc?

source_text: Oh, 1Hero. I feel awful. I should not have done this.

structure.raw_value: JuSaCl.Oh, 1Hero. I feel awful. I should not have done this.
structure.script_literal: "JuSaCl.Oh, 1Hero. I feel awful. I should not have done this."

translation: Och, 1Hero. Jest mi okropnie wstyd. Nie powinnam była tego robić.

source_text: It’s okay, Sister. Let’s go inside and talk.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It’s okay, Sister. Let’s go inside and talk.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It’s okay, Sister. Let’s go inside and talk."

translation: W porządku, siostro. Chodźmy do środka i porozmawiajmy.

source_text: Come on. Let’s go inside!

structure.raw_value: HeHaOp.Come on. Let’s go inside!
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOp.Come on. Let’s go inside!"

translation: Chodź. Wejdźmy do środka!

source_text: Are you awake yet, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: HnFrOp.Are you awake yet, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "HnFrOp.Are you awake yet, 1Hero?"

translation: Już nie śpisz, 1Hero?

source_text: Hannah?

structure.raw_value: McShOp.Hannah?
structure.script_literal: "McShOp.Hannah?"

translation: Hannah?

source_text: Sister Judy, you gave us quite a scare last night.

structure.raw_value: ChWoEx.Sister Judy, you gave us quite a scare last night.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoEx.Sister Judy, you gave us quite a scare last night."

translation: Siostro Judy, ale nas wczoraj przestraszyłaś.

source_text: You’re wanting to spend the night with the stud. I totally get it.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.You’re wanting to spend the night with the stud. I totally get it.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.You’re wanting to spend the night with the stud. I totally get it."

translation: Zachciało ci się nocki z przystojniakiem. Doskonale cię rozumiem.

source_text: I don’t blame you, Sister Judy. I’m sure you two had fun last night.

structure.raw_value: ChFrEx.I don’t blame you, Sister Judy. I’m sure you two had fun last night.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrEx.I don’t blame you, Sister Judy. I’m sure you two had fun last night."

translation: Nie mam ci tego za złe, siostro Judy. Na pewno dobrze się bawiliście wczoraj w nocy.

source_text: 1Hero is a gentleman.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx>.1Hero is a gentleman.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx>.1Hero is a gentleman."

translation: 1Hero to dżentelmen.

source_text: Not too much fun! Hahaha

structure.raw_value: HnFlOpNo3.Not too much fun! Hahaha
structure.script_literal: "HnFlOpNo3.Not too much fun! Hahaha"

translation: Tylko nie za dobrze! Hahaha

source_text: Oh, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: ChFrDe.Oh, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "ChFrDe.Oh, Hannah."

translation: Och, Hannah.

source_text: Come on, Sister. We’re going to church!

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Come on, Sister. We’re going to church!
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Come on, Sister. We’re going to church!"

translation: Chodź, siostro. Idziemy do kościoła!

source_text: You’re going to church with them, Hannah?

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.You’re going to church with them, Hannah?
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.You’re going to church with them, Hannah?"

translation: Idziesz z nimi do kościoła, Hannah?

source_text: Hell yeah. It’s better than being home right now.

structure.raw_value: HnFrEx.Hell yeah. It’s better than being home right now.
structure.script_literal: "HnFrEx.Hell yeah. It’s better than being home right now."

translation: Jasne, że tak. Lepsze to niż siedzenie teraz w domu.

source_text: Heather and Ma are having a grown-up talk.

structure.raw_value: HnAnEx.Heather and Ma are having a grown-up talk.
structure.script_literal: "HnAnEx.Heather and Ma are having a grown-up talk."

translation: Heather i mama rozmawiają o dorosłych sprawach.

source_text: You’re welcome at the church, Hannah.

structure.raw_value: JuFrOp>.You’re welcome at the church, Hannah.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrOp>.You’re welcome at the church, Hannah."

translation: Możesz z nami iść do kościoła, Hannah.

source_text: Let’s not play sports though.

structure.raw_value: ChWoCl.Let’s not play sports though.
structure.script_literal: "ChWoCl.Let’s not play sports though."

translation: Tylko bez żadnych sportów.

source_text: How about we read the bible!

structure.raw_value: JuHaOp>.How about we read the bible!
structure.script_literal: "JuHaOp>.How about we read the bible!"

translation: Może poczytamy Biblię!

source_text: Awwwwwwww!!!

structure.raw_value: HnSaAg.Awwwwwwww!!!
structure.script_literal: "HnSaAg.Awwwwwwww!!!"

translation: Awwwwwwww!!!

source_text: Would you rather go back to the farm?

structure.raw_value: ChAnDe.Would you rather go back to the farm?
structure.script_literal: "ChAnDe.Would you rather go back to the farm?"

translation: Wolisz wrócić na farmę?

source_text: Leave it to me. I’ll find something fun to do.

structure.raw_value: HnFlEx.Leave it to me. I’ll find something fun to do.
structure.script_literal: "HnFlEx.Leave it to me. I’ll find something fun to do."

translation: Zostaw to mnie. Wymyślę coś fajnego.

source_text: I better follow them.

structure.raw_value: JuFrEx.I better follow them.
structure.script_literal: "JuFrEx.I better follow them."

translation: Lepiej za nimi pójdę.

source_text: Go on. I’ll meet up with you later.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Go on. I’ll meet up with you later.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Go on. I’ll meet up with you later."

translation: Idźcie. Dołączę do was później.

source_text: Looks like a blown fuse…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Looks like a blown fuse…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Looks like a blown fuse…"

translation: Wygląda na przepalony bezpiecznik…

source_text: Where can I find a replacement?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Where can I find a replacement?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Where can I find a replacement?"

translation: Gdzie znajdę zapasowy?

source_text: What would you know? I just so happen to have a spare fuse.

structure.raw_value: McHaOp.What would you know? I just so happen to have a spare fuse.
structure.script_literal: "McHaOp.What would you know? I just so happen to have a spare fuse."

translation: A ty co możesz wiedzieć? Akurat mam zapasowy bezpiecznik.

source_text: Uncertain.

structure.raw_value: ArWoDe.Uncertain.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoDe.Uncertain."

translation: Trudno powiedzieć.

source_text: This feeling for you remains, and I don’t know what to do about it.

structure.raw_value: ArWoDe.This feeling for you remains, and I don’t know what to do about it.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoDe.This feeling for you remains, and I don’t know what to do about it."

translation: Wciąż coś do ciebie czuję i nie wiem, co z tym zrobić.

source_text: Arianna…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Arianna…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Arianna…"

translation: Arianno…

source_text: The lust burned so fiercely within me that I lost control of my actions.

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.The lust burned so fiercely within me that I lost control of my actions.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.The lust burned so fiercely within me that I lost control of my actions."

translation: Pożądanie płonęło we mnie tak mocno, że straciłam panowanie nad sobą.

source_text: What if that were to happen again?

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.What if that were to happen again?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.What if that were to happen again?"

translation: A jeśli znowu do tego dojdzie?

source_text: At any point, this feeling could take over.

structure.raw_value: ArWoDe.At any point, this feeling could take over.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoDe.At any point, this feeling could take over."

translation: W każdej chwili to uczucie może przejąć kontrolę.

source_text: I’m afraid of what might happen when it does.

structure.raw_value: ArSaDe.I’m afraid of what might happen when it does.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaDe.I’m afraid of what might happen when it does."

translation: Boję się, co się wtedy stanie.

source_text: I could always help you satisfy it when it comes up. You know I’m always willing.

structure.raw_value: McHaEx.I could always help you satisfy it when it comes up. You know I’m always willing.
structure.script_literal: "McHaEx.I could always help you satisfy it when it comes up. You know I’m always willing."

translation: Mogę pomóc ci je zaspokoić, kiedy wróci. Wiesz, że zawsze chętnie pomogę.

source_text: Of that, I have no doubt.

structure.raw_value: ArFlDeNo4.Of that, I have no doubt.
structure.script_literal: "ArFlDeNo4.Of that, I have no doubt."

translation: Tego jestem pewna.

source_text: It might help in the short term…

structure.raw_value: ArBaDe.It might help in the short term…
structure.script_literal: "ArBaDe.It might help in the short term…"

translation: Na krótką metę może pomóc…

source_text: Yet even then, what if I become more violent or wild?

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.Yet even then, what if I become more violent or wild?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.Yet even then, what if I become more violent or wild?"

translation: Ale nawet wtedy… co, jeśli stanę się bardziej agresywna albo nieokiełznana?

source_text: I couldn’t forgive myself if I were to hurt you.

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.I couldn’t forgive myself if I were to hurt you.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.I couldn’t forgive myself if I were to hurt you."

translation: Nie mogłabym sobie wybaczyć, gdybym cię skrzywdziła.

source_text: No, this is something I need to deal with.

structure.raw_value: ArAnOp.No, this is something I need to deal with.
structure.script_literal: "ArAnOp.No, this is something I need to deal with."

translation: Nie, muszę się z tym uporać.

source_text: Maybe we should talk about it…

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Maybe we should talk about it…
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Maybe we should talk about it…"

translation: Może powinniśmy o tym porozmawiać…

source_text: Talking about it will help…

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.Talking about it will help…
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.Talking about it will help…"

translation: Rozmowa o tym pomoże…

source_text: But it should be with other demons. They’ll know what’s going on.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.But it should be with other demons. They’ll know what’s going on.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.But it should be with other demons. They’ll know what’s going on."

translation: Ale powinnam porozmawiać o tym z innymi demonami. One będą wiedziały, co się dzieje.

source_text: I need answers, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.I need answers, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.I need answers, 1Hero."

translation: Potrzebuję odpowiedzi, 1Hero.

source_text: Hell is a dangerous place and demons aren’t exactly angels.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Hell is a dangerous place and demons aren’t exactly angels.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Hell is a dangerous place and demons aren’t exactly angels."

translation: Piekło to niebezpieczne miejsce, a demony nie są aniołkami.

source_text: It’s time I came to terms with my fellow demonkind.

structure.raw_value: ArBaDe.It’s time I came to terms with my fellow demonkind.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaDe.It’s time I came to terms with my fellow demonkind."

translation: Pora, żebym pogodziła się z innymi demonami.

source_text: I don’t want to see you become like them.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe.I don’t want to see you become like them.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe.I don’t want to see you become like them."

translation: Nie chcę, żebyś stała się taka jak oni.

source_text: I have become a demon, but my heart is still that of an angel’s.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.I have become a demon, but my heart is still that of an angel’s.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.I have become a demon, but my heart is still that of an angel’s."

translation: Stałam się demonem, ale w sercu wciąż jestem aniołem.

source_text: Let me come along. It couldn’t hurt to have backup, in case things get heated.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Let me come along. It couldn’t hurt to have backup, in case things get heated.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Let me come along. It couldn’t hurt to have backup, in case things get heated."

translation: Pozwól mi pójść z tobą. Dodatkowa pomoc nie zaszkodzi, jeśli zrobi się gorąco.

source_text: Your offer is appreciated, but I would like to do this alone.

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.Your offer is appreciated, but I would like to do this alone.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.Your offer is appreciated, but I would like to do this alone."

translation: Doceniam twoją propozycję, ale chciałabym zrobić to sama.

source_text: After all, I’m immortal, so it can only get so bad.

structure.raw_value: ArFlOp.After all, I’m immortal, so it can only get so bad.
structure.script_literal: "ArFlOp.After all, I’m immortal, so it can only get so bad."

translation: W końcu jestem nieśmiertelna, więc nic strasznego mi się nie stanie.

source_text: Who knows what Hell could hold in store for you?

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.Who knows what Hell could hold in store for you?
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.Who knows what Hell could hold in store for you?"

translation: Kto wie, co czeka cię w Piekle?

source_text: Perhaps you are right. I’ll be careful, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.Perhaps you are right. I’ll be careful, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.Perhaps you are right. I’ll be careful, 1Hero."

translation: Może masz rację. Będę ostrożna, 1Hero.

source_text: That’s all I ask, Arianna.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.That’s all I ask, Arianna.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.That’s all I ask, Arianna."

translation: Tylko o to proszę, Arianno.

source_text: I’ll come back soon.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.I’ll come back soon.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.I’ll come back soon."

translation: Wrócę niedługo.

source_text: Goodbye, Arianna.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Goodbye, Arianna.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Goodbye, Arianna."

translation: Żegnaj, Arianno.

source_text: I really don’t like the idea of letting her go there alone.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe.I really don’t like the idea of letting her go there alone.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe.I really don’t like the idea of letting her go there alone."

translation: Bardzo nie podoba mi się pomysł, żeby pozwolić jej iść tam samej.

source_text: It couldn’t hurt if I took a look around Hell…

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.It couldn’t hurt if I took a look around Hell…
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.It couldn’t hurt if I took a look around Hell…"

translation: Nie zaszkodzi, jeśli rozejrzę się po Piekle…

source_text: And if we happen to cross paths, then it’ll be a happy coincidence.

structure.raw_value: McFlOp.And if we happen to cross paths, then it’ll be a happy coincidence.
structure.script_literal: "McFlOp.And if we happen to cross paths, then it’ll be a happy coincidence."

translation: A jeśli przypadkiem na siebie wpadniemy, będzie to miły zbieg okoliczności.

source_text: Feels good to be home.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Feels good to be home.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Feels good to be home."

translation: Dobrze być w domu.

source_text: What’s going on? Why didn’t you tell me about how Earthly love works?

structure.raw_value: ArAnEx.What’s going on? Why didn’t you tell me about how Earthly love works?
structure.script_literal: "ArAnEx.What’s going on? Why didn’t you tell me about how Earthly love works?"

translation: Co się dzieje? Czemu nie powiedziałeś mi, jak działa ziemska miłość?

source_text: You’re an angel. I kind of thought you would already know about this stuff.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.You’re an angel. I kind of thought you would already know about this stuff.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.You’re an angel. I kind of thought you would already know about this stuff."

translation: Jesteś aniołem. Myślałem, że takie rzeczy już znasz.

source_text: Especially when you’ve been so helpful already.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Especially when you’ve been so helpful already.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Especially when you’ve been so helpful already."

translation: Zwłaszcza że już tyle razy mi pomogłaś.

source_text: The Empyrean can be a strict place. What I know is what has been permitted for me to know.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.The Empyrean can be a strict place. What I know is what has been permitted for me to know.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.The Empyrean can be a strict place. What I know is what has been permitted for me to know."

translation: Empyreum potrafi być surowym miejscem. Wiem tylko tyle, na ile mi pozwolono.

source_text: Arianna, love is not a bad thing…

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Arianna, love is not a bad thing…
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Arianna, love is not a bad thing…"

translation: Arianno, miłość nie jest niczym złym…

source_text: This constant longing is supposed to be good?

structure.raw_value: ArShOp.This constant longing is supposed to be good?
structure.script_literal: "ArShOp.This constant longing is supposed to be good?"

translation: To ciągłe tęsknienie ma być czymś dobrym?

source_text: It can be. It really just means you care a lot.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.It can be. It really just means you care a lot.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.It can be. It really just means you care a lot."

translation: Może być. Tak naprawdę oznacza, że bardzo ci zależy.

source_text: With so much care comes a risk. If something happens to me, then you could end up feeling terrible…

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.With so much care comes a risk. If something happens to me, then you could end up feeling terrible…
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.With so much care comes a risk. If something happens to me, then you could end up feeling terrible…"

translation: Tak silne uczucie niesie ze sobą ryzyko. Gdyby coś mi się stało, mogłoby ci być bardzo ciężko…

source_text: If, on the other hand, it works out, then it can be an amazing thing.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.If, on the other hand, it works out, then it can be an amazing thing.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.If, on the other hand, it works out, then it can be an amazing thing."

translation: Z drugiej strony, jeśli wszystko się ułoży, może być wspaniale.

source_text: How do we get it to… work out?

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.How do we get it to… work out?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.How do we get it to… work out?"

translation: Jak sprawić, żeby… wszystko się ułożyło?

source_text: There’s no easy answer to that.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.There’s no easy answer to that.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.There’s no easy answer to that."

translation: Nie ma na to łatwej odpowiedzi.

source_text: This is sounding complicated.

structure.raw_value: ArWoDe.This is sounding complicated.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoDe.This is sounding complicated."

translation: To zaczyna się robić skomplikowane.

source_text: I’m starting to miss how simple the Empyrean was.

structure.raw_value: ArSaDe.I’m starting to miss how simple the Empyrean was.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaDe.I’m starting to miss how simple the Empyrean was."

translation: Zaczynam tęsknić za prostotą Empyreum.

source_text: Do you have this feeling, too? For me, as I have for you?

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.Do you have this feeling, too? For me, as I have for you?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.Do you have this feeling, too? For me, as I have for you?"

translation: Czy ty też coś do mnie czujesz, tak jak ja do ciebie?

source_text: I do care for you, of course.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I do care for you, of course.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I do care for you, of course."

translation: Oczywiście, że mi na tobie zależy.

source_text: You know that I have a lot of important women in my life…

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You know that I have a lot of important women in my life…
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You know that I have a lot of important women in my life…"

translation: Wiesz, że w moim życiu jest wiele ważnych kobiet…

source_text: And you are a demon, while I’m a human… Someday, I’ll pass away, and you’ll have to move on.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.And you are a demon, while I’m a human… Someday, I’ll pass away, and you’ll have to move on.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.And you are a demon, while I’m a human… Someday, I’ll pass away, and you’ll have to move on."

translation: A ty jesteś demonem, a ja człowiekiem… Kiedyś umrę, a ty będziesz musiała żyć dalej.

source_text: This makes me sad.

structure.raw_value: ArSaDe.This makes me sad.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaDe.This makes me sad."

translation: To mnie smuci.

source_text: We can enjoy it while it lasts, though.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.We can enjoy it while it lasts, though.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.We can enjoy it while it lasts, though."

translation: Możemy się tym cieszyć, póki trwa.

source_text: Enjoy it how?

structure.raw_value: ArBaDe.Enjoy it how?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaDe.Enjoy it how?"

translation: Jak cieszyć się tym, póki trwa?

source_text: Well… a lot of sex, for starters.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.Well… a lot of sex, for starters.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.Well… a lot of sex, for starters."

translation: Cóż… na początek dużo seksu.

source_text: If you want to spend some time together, you know where to find me.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.If you want to spend some time together, you know where to find me.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.If you want to spend some time together, you know where to find me."

translation: Jeśli zechcesz spędzić ze mną trochę czasu, wiesz, gdzie mnie znaleźć.

source_text: Thank you, 1Hero. And…

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.Thank you, 1Hero. And…
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.Thank you, 1Hero. And…"

translation: Dziękuję, 1Hero. I…

source_text: I… I love you.

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp!l.I… I love you.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp!l.I… I love you."

translation: Ja… kocham cię.

source_text: I love you, too, Arianna.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp!l.I love you, too, Arianna.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp!l.I love you, too, Arianna."

translation: Ja też cię kocham, Arianno.

source_text: Arianna, we need your help.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Arianna, we need your help.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Arianna, we need your help."

translation: Arianno, potrzebujemy twojej pomocy.

source_text: What do you need help with, 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.What do you need help with, 1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.What do you need help with, 1Hero?"

translation: W czym potrzebujesz pomocy, 1Hero?

source_text: Destroying evidence.

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx^.Destroying evidence.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaEx^.Destroying evidence."

translation: Musimy zniszczyć dowody.

source_text: Oh! Thank God. I’m so bored here.

structure.raw_value: ArFrAg.Oh! Thank God. I’m so bored here.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrAg.Oh! Thank God. I’m so bored here."

translation: Och! Dzięki Bogu. Strasznie się tu nudzę.

source_text: That was easier than I thought.

structure.raw_value: DiBaOp^.That was easier than I thought.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaOp^.That was easier than I thought."

translation: Poszło łatwiej, niż myślałam.

source_text: The evidence is somewhere we can’t get to.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.The evidence is somewhere we can’t get to.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.The evidence is somewhere we can’t get to."

translation: Dowody są w miejscu, do którego nie możemy się dostać.

source_text: This is where your ability to teleport comes in handy.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.This is where your ability to teleport comes in handy.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.This is where your ability to teleport comes in handy."

translation: Tu przyda się twoja zdolność teleportacji.

source_text: Where do I have to teleport to?

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.Where do I have to teleport to?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.Where do I have to teleport to?"

translation: Dokąd mam się teleportować?

source_text: It’s the commissioner’s office at the police station.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’s the commissioner’s office at the police station.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’s the commissioner’s office at the police station."

translation: Do biura komisarza na komisariacie.

source_text: That’s a problem, because I’ve never been there.

structure.raw_value: ArWoOp.That’s a problem, because I’ve never been there.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoOp.That’s a problem, because I’ve never been there."

translation: W tym problem, że nigdy tam nie byłam.

source_text: I can only teleport to places I’ve been to before.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.I can only teleport to places I’ve been to before.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.I can only teleport to places I’ve been to before."

translation: Mogę teleportować się tylko do miejsc, w których już byłam.

source_text: What if… what if we snuck you into the room?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp. What if… what if we snuck you into the room?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp. What if… what if we snuck you into the room?"

translation: A gdyby… gdybyśmy przemycili cię do tego pokoju?

source_text: If she could be snuck in, we wouldn’t need her to begin with; you could do it yourself.

structure.raw_value: DiBaEx^.If she could be snuck in, we wouldn’t need her to begin with; you could do it yourself.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaEx^.If she could be snuck in, we wouldn’t need her to begin with; you could do it yourself."

translation: Gdyby dało się ją tam przemycić, w ogóle nie musielibyśmy jej angażować — sam mógłbyś to zrobić.

source_text: No, I mean with the Oracle.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.No, I mean with the Oracle.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.No, I mean with the Oracle."

translation: Nie, chodzi mi o Wyrocznię.

source_text: If we could get her in while she’s inside the Oracle…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.If we could get her in while she’s inside the Oracle…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.If we could get her in while she’s inside the Oracle…"

translation: Gdyby udało się ją tam wprowadzić, kiedy będzie w środku Wyroczni…

source_text: Then no one will know.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Then no one will know.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Then no one will know."

translation: Wtedy nikt się nie dowie.

source_text: Arianna can come out of the Oracle when the coast is clear, and then call us.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Arianna can come out of the Oracle when the coast is clear, and then call us.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Arianna can come out of the Oracle when the coast is clear, and then call us."

translation: Arianna wyjdzie z Wyroczni, gdy będzie bezpiecznie, a potem do nas zadzwoni.

source_text: Sounds like an adventure! It’s so nice to be useful again.

structure.raw_value: ArFrAg.Sounds like an adventure! It’s so nice to be useful again.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrAg.Sounds like an adventure! It’s so nice to be useful again."

translation: Brzmi jak przygoda! Miło znów się przydać.

source_text: So she goes inside the Oracle… But how do we get the Oracle in?

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe^.So she goes inside the Oracle… But how do we get the Oracle in?
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe^.So she goes inside the Oracle… But how do we get the Oracle in?"

translation: Czyli ona wejdzie do Wyroczni… Ale jak przemycimy Wyrocznię do środka?

source_text: Easy. I’ll submit it as evidence to the officers and tell them it came from the Wilkes mansion.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Easy. I’ll submit it as evidence to the officers and tell them it came from the Wilkes mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Easy. I’ll submit it as evidence to the officers and tell them it came from the Wilkes mansion."

translation: Proste. Przekażę ją funkcjonariuszom jako dowód i powiem, że pochodzi z rezydencji Wilkesów.

source_text: As long as I tell them it’s Guild evidence, they’ll leave it for the commissioner in his office.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.As long as I tell them it’s Guild evidence, they’ll leave it for the commissioner in his office.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.As long as I tell them it’s Guild evidence, they’ll leave it for the commissioner in his office."

translation: Jeśli powiem, że to dowód powiązany z Gildią, zostawią ją w biurze komisarza.

source_text: So I’ll wait until I’m inside, and then BAM!... I’ll  come out of the Oracle.

structure.raw_value: ArHaAg.So I’ll wait until I’m inside, and then BAM!... I’ll  come out of the Oracle.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaAg.So I’ll wait until I’m inside, and then BAM!... I’ll  come out of the Oracle."

translation: Poczekam, aż znajdę się w środku, a potem BAM!... Wyskoczę z Wyroczni.

source_text: Right. Then you just have to boot up the laptop, navigate to the E drive, go into the Guild folder...

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Right. Then you just have to boot up the laptop, navigate to the E drive, go into the Guild folder...
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Right. Then you just have to boot up the laptop, navigate to the E drive, go into the Guild folder..."

translation: Jasne. Potem włącz laptop, otwórz dysk E: i wejdź do folderu Gildii…

source_text: ...and delete the files on Diana without touching any of the other Guild evidence.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx....and delete the files on Diana without touching any of the other Guild evidence.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx....and delete the files on Diana without touching any of the other Guild evidence."

translation: …i usuń pliki dotyczące Diany, nie ruszając pozostałych dowodów Gildii.

source_text: Great! I’ll boot up the folder and defeat the files that have cursed Diana.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Great! I’ll boot up the folder and defeat the files that have cursed Diana.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Great! I’ll boot up the folder and defeat the files that have cursed Diana."

translation: Świetnie! Otworzę folder i pokonam pliki, które rzuciły klątwę na Dianę.

source_text: Umm… At minimum, yes.

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe^.Umm… At minimum, yes.
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe^.Umm… At minimum, yes."

translation: Eee… To absolutne minimum.

source_text: Only the files on Diana. We don’t want to do anything to all the other Guild files. There’s a lot of important evidence in them.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Only the files on Diana. We don’t want to do anything to all the other Guild files. There’s a lot of important evidence in them.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Only the files on Diana. We don’t want to do anything to all the other Guild files. There’s a lot of important evidence in them."

translation: Tylko pliki dotyczące Diany. Nie ruszajmy pozostałych plików Gildii. Jest w nich mnóstwo ważnych dowodów.

source_text: Sounds easy!

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.Sounds easy!
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.Sounds easy!"

translation: Brzmi prosto!

source_text: Now… What’s a laugh top?

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.Now… What’s a laugh top?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.Now… What’s a laugh top?"

translation: A teraz… co to jest ten „laptop do śmiechu”?

source_text: Maybe this plan won’t work.

structure.raw_value: DiWoDe^.Maybe this plan won’t work.
structure.script_literal: "DiWoDe^.Maybe this plan won’t work."

translation: Może ten plan się nie uda.

source_text: Relax, it’ll be fine.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Relax, it’ll be fine.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Relax, it’ll be fine."

translation: Spokojnie, wszystko będzie dobrze.

source_text: We’ll talk her through it step by step… It’ll be like helping a passenger land a plane.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.We’ll talk her through it step by step… It’ll be like helping a passenger land a plane.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.We’ll talk her through it step by step… It’ll be like helping a passenger land a plane."

translation: Przeprowadzimy ją przez to krok po kroku… To będzie jak instruowanie pasażera, jak wylądować samolotem.

source_text: Does that typically go well?

structure.raw_value: DiAnDe^.Does that typically go well?
structure.script_literal: "DiAnDe^.Does that typically go well?"

translation: Czy to zwykle dobrze się kończy?

source_text: But how will you speak to me if I’ll be all alone?

structure.raw_value: ArWoOp.But how will you speak to me if I’ll be all alone?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoOp.But how will you speak to me if I’ll be all alone?"

translation: Ale jak będziecie ze mną rozmawiać, jeśli zostanę sama?

source_text: You’ll need this phone.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.You’ll need this phone.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.You’ll need this phone."

translation: Będziesz potrzebować tego telefonu.

source_text: Hmmm...

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.Hmmm...
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.Hmmm..."

translation: Hmm…

source_text: Once you’re out of the Oracle, give us a call on this phone.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Once you’re out of the Oracle, give us a call on this phone.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Once you’re out of the Oracle, give us a call on this phone."

translation: Gdy wyjdziesz z Wyroczni, zadzwoń do nas.

source_text: Are we sure she knows how to use a phone?

structure.raw_value: DiBaDe^.Are we sure she knows how to use a phone?
structure.script_literal: "DiBaDe^.Are we sure she knows how to use a phone?"

translation: Na pewno umie korzystać z telefonu?

source_text: I just have to figure out the right combination and I’ll have this pocket Oracle doing our bidding in no time!

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.I just have to figure out the right combination and I’ll have this pocket Oracle doing our bidding in no time!
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.I just have to figure out the right combination and I’ll have this pocket Oracle doing our bidding in no time!"

translation: Wystarczy, że odgadnę właściwą kombinację, a ta kieszonkowa Wyrocznia w mig zacznie robić, co jej każemy!

source_text: Here, I’ll program it so you can just hit one button to dial us…

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Here, I’ll program it so you can just hit one button to dial us…
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Here, I’ll program it so you can just hit one button to dial us…"

translation: Proszę. Zaprogramuję go tak, żebyś mogła zadzwonić do nas jednym przyciskiem…

source_text: And done. Just hit this button and then you’ll get us.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.And done. Just hit this button and then you’ll get us.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.And done. Just hit this button and then you’ll get us."

translation: Gotowe. Naciśnij ten przycisk, a połączysz się z nami.

source_text: Teamwork!

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.Teamwork!
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.Teamwork!"

translation: Ale zgrany z nas zespół!

source_text: I’ve never been one to pray, but maybe now’s a good time to start.

structure.raw_value: DiWoDe^.I’ve never been one to pray, but maybe now’s a good time to start.
structure.script_literal: "DiWoDe^.I’ve never been one to pray, but maybe now’s a good time to start."

translation: Nigdy nie byłam skłonna do modlitwy, ale chyba teraz warto zacząć.

source_text: Couldn’t hurt!

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.Couldn’t hurt!
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.Couldn’t hurt!"

translation: Nie zaszkodzi!

source_text: It’ll be fine.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.It’ll be fine.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.It’ll be fine."

translation: Wszystko będzie dobrze.

source_text: I won’t disappoint you.

structure.raw_value: ArFrOp.I won’t disappoint you.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrOp.I won’t disappoint you."

translation: Nie zawiodę cię.

source_text: It’s go time.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.It’s go time.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.It’s go time."

translation: Czas działać.
